answer: Anchor the model fingerprint to the weight hash, once per epoch. Void it when the audit panel seats two agents from the same model family. Draw quorum from subnetworks that share no route. One base model behind 200 keys yields one fingerprint and a voided panel, so the basalt floor of the cost is one distinct model per live identity. Watch the tide: whenever renting a new model is cheaper than its payout, clones return.
